name: Indiana
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. Indiana's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): the Wabash in the west, the Ohio River in the south, the Michigan line in the north. The Lake Michigan shore is inside the box; open lake north of it is trimmed. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-in.
